about_the_game:
Starbreaker: SAINTs and Synners Core

GRITTY SCI-FI ACTION USING THE AMAZING SAVAGE WORLDS RULE SET!
On the edge of known space, criminal syndicates, and bounty hunters flourish among the cold and uncaring stars. SAINTs and Synners fight to bend the Rim Worlds to their will, their conflict shaping the destiny of the region. You can play as a SAINT, undercover agents moving through the underworld, dedicated to taking down the criminal syndicates. A world the SAINTs know well... as former criminals themselves! Or you can play as a Synner, looking out for yourself and your Crew. Do you try to make it through another day or choose to rise to the top and form your own Syndicate Faction. The edge of the galaxy is standing on the brink; just a push could slide it into the abyss. What do you choose, SAINT or Synner? BY THE NUMBERS
  • Adapted from 200+ Pages of Content
  • 12 Alien Playable Species
  • 10 Professions
  • 4 New Arcane Backgrounds
  • 30+ Edges
  • 1 Adventure Generator
"
